symptom: ako/mxcli#2027: a blank app at security level Off with module roles, XPath-constrained entity access, page grants and demo users passed check --references, lint, mx check and test --local; at runtime a customer read 10 of 10 tickets, opened ungranted pages, and no demo user existed. At Prototype pages were guarded but every row was still readable.
cause: Nothing compared the security level with the security the project defines; SEC010-SEC012 return early below Production, so the levels that ignore the rules were exactly the ones no rule looked at.
insight: A rule that only runs at Production is silent precisely where the rules it checks are not applied; the level itself needs a rule. Count only the project's own modules (Source empty), or every blank app warns about Administration's marketplace rules.
